# Real-world scenarios

Scenario automation added under this directory must record the application ref, Qt exact version, OS/toolchain, HyRemote SHA, mode, viewer/transport version and evidence classification.

Required rows eventually exercise local baseline, view-only, framebuffer updates, pointer/keyboard/text, secondary windows where applicable, reconnect, abrupt held-input disconnect cleanup, explicit stop/policy transition cleanup, no late input after stop, local+remote coexistence and teardown.

A scenario must never silently convert a foreign-native or graphics-backend observation into a product support claim.
